# Shop online program

## Table of Contents

- [Justification](#justification) — why sell online now
- [Vision](#vision) — the end state
- [Strategic alignment](#strategic-alignment) — the 2027 growth objective
- [Benefits](#benefits) — SM-1, SM-2
- [Scope](#scope) — in and out of the program
- [Initiatives](#initiatives) — cart, then search
- [Rules](#rules) — RULE-1, RULE-2
- [Stakeholders](#stakeholders) — who is affected
- [Governance](#governance) — sponsor and decision rights
- [Timeline](#timeline) — phases
- [Risks and issues](#risks-and-issues) — owners

## Justification

Phone orders cap what the shop can sell; without an online channel it keeps losing customers who will not call.

## Vision

Any shopper finds a product, prices it and orders it online, at any hour.

## Strategic alignment

Serves the shop's 2027 objective of doubling orders without new staff.

## Benefits

- SM-1: Online orders reach 500 a week by June 2027. Owner: Dana (sales).
- SM-2: Phone orders fall by half by June 2027. Owner: Dana (sales).

## Scope

In: the online storefront, cart, checkout and search. Out: in-store sales and warehouse systems.

## Initiatives

1. initiative-cart: shoppers keep a cart and check out.
2. initiative-search: shoppers find products by name; it waits on the cart's product page.

## Rules

- RULE-1: Every price shown to a shopper comes from the one pricing source.
- RULE-2: The shop never stores card data.

## Stakeholders

Sales, finance, the warehouse team and shoppers.

## Governance

Sponsor: Lee (owner). Lee decides scope, Dana decides priorities; monthly review.

## Timeline

Cart live in Q1 2027, search in Q2 2027.

## Risks and issues

- The payment provider's contract is unsigned. Owner: Lee.
